My First Band

我的第一支乐队 · 164 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1I was very sensitive to music. After briefly dipping into a music book, I could sing or play the piece well. To be honest, I always dreamt of becoming a famous folk performer. I was so confident that I never lost my dedication.

2I formed my first band called “Rolling Frog”. At first, we earned extra cash by playing our instruments in pubs or for passers-by. Then we wore false beards to pretend to be the musicians whom people were familiar with. In addition, we added humorous acts to our performances and played jokes on each other. Soon, our “funny jazz” became famous and radio stations began inviting us to perform on their broadcasts. Afterwards, we sorted through our music, picked out the most attractive pieces and made a record in a studio. A million or so copies were sold and we became millionaires.

3It was painful when the band finally broke up. But above all, I realized my dream of becoming a musician.

高考英语3500词 · 10中文译文

我的第一支乐队

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1我对音乐很敏感。只要翻一翻乐谱，我就能唱得或弹得不错。说实话，我一直梦想成为有名的民间艺人。我很有信心，也始终肯为此下功夫。

2我组建了第一支乐队，名字叫“滚动青蛙”。起初，我们在酒吧里演奏，也在街头弹给过路人听，赚些额外的现钱。后来，我们戴上假胡子，扮成人们熟悉的音乐家。我们还在节目里加了些滑稽表演，在台上互相开玩笑。没过多久，我们的“搞笑爵士乐”出了名，电台开始邀请我们去表演。再后来，我们挑出好听的曲子，进录音棚录了一张唱片。唱片卖出大约一百万张，我们也成了百万富翁。

3乐队最终解散，我很难过。不过，最重要的是，我当音乐家的梦想实现了。
